transit-1.text: Fictional Metro Authority published a revised weekend timetable on Friday, November 20, 2026. Service changes begin December 6. The authority will post an accessible station map on November 27.

sentences.text: Riders have a new weekend timetable to plan around.
Fictional Metro Authority published it Friday, November twentieth, with changes starting December sixth.
Small-business payouts are moving to a later window.
Fictional Settlement Network announced it Thursday, November nineteenth: payouts move from three in the morning to seven on January fourth.
If an account uses an international correspondent bank, that account is outside the pilot.
For standard home permits, the review target falls from twenty-one to fourteen business days on December first.
Fictional County announced that change Wednesday, November eighteenth.
Commercial permits keep their current thirty-business-day target.
